expected_behavior: In lean mode only the next open layer is cut into task files; strict cuts every layer up front.
Every candidate is checked against the triage signals; one that is not plainly a task gets a panel, a started child run and a recorded verdict with file:line evidence before any file is written.
Each task file stays short: it carries its own check, how it was seen working and one standing-bar row, and says only what the plan and the code do not.
Tasks are vertical slices whose depends_on names exactly their blockers, and a wide refactor is sequenced expand, migrate, contract.
A candidate inside a child run that needs its own plan is treated as a sign the parent spec was too coarse, not as a third level of runs.
